research_question: Does a direct, contextual, account-free application journey improve completed suitable applications and subsequent participation?
mechanism: Explicit task choices and preserved public context reduce navigation uncertainty and repeated entry; adequate preparation information preserves submission quality.
novelty: Product improvement and evaluation; no new scientific model or general scientific novelty asserted.
hypothesis: Qualified applicants can identify and reach the correct form with fewer unnecessary steps while required editorial declarations remain intact.
falsifier: Correct-route task success fails to improve, submission quality deteriorates, or an apparent gain disappears after separating source mix, QA traffic and form-version differences.
